event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Broad risk-off, small caps and chips hit hardest.
Philly Fed printed 6.3 vs 20 fc and LEI -0.3% vs 0% fc, confirming the growth scare; SPY and QQQ both closed below their 200-day MAs, and SPY drew +$9.4bn of inflows into the drawdown while SOXX bled -$4.5bn. Dec 9 hike odds at 100% (CME) mean no policy cushion, so this is a de-risking tape, not a dip-buy.

INDICES — VIX 24.6, +12.2% via VIXY. Ranked: RSP -1.76%, SPY -1.96%, IJH -2.02%, DIA -2.18%, IWM -2.18%, QQQ -2.19%, SOXX -2.75%. Large < small by 0.22pp (large -1.96% vs small -2.18%) — no size refuge. SPY and QQQ below their 200-day MAs: CTA sell trigger active. Bonds bid quietly (IEF +0.17%, TLT +0.16%) while gold -1.76% and silver -2.60%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.5x on -1.96% = distribution; QQQ 1.6x (XLK) on -1.90% = distribution; IJS 15.9x on -2.26% is capitulation-style selling. XLK/XLF/XLV all 1.6x gaining nothing — heavy two-way churn, not accumulation. Breadth is broken: 38 advancers vs 463 decliners, only 49% above the 50-DMA and 48% above the 200-DMA, up/down volume 0.13, new 60d highs/lows 1/67. Participation diverges hard from index levels — this is broad liquidation, not a narrow mega-cap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy -0.65%, XLU Utilities -1.24%, XLP Staples -1.45%, XLF Financials -1.49%, XLRE Real Estate -1.70%, XLK Technology -1.90%, XLI Industrials -2.00%, XLV Healthcare -2.05%, XLB Materials -2.06%, XLC Comms -2.67%, XLY Discretionary -2.79%. Top industries USO +1.45% vs bottom SILJ -5.66% and MSOS -5.59%. Flows: XLK +$970mm (100p) and XLP +$242mm (83p) in; XLU -$894mm (0p) and XLE -$674mm (8p) out. Leaders bleeding price but taking inflows (XLK) = dip-buying, not conviction rotation. Strongest: energy relative, staples; weakest: discretionary, comms. Label: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.73 (complacent), QQQ 0.95, IWM 1.52 (heavy protection); skew +13.7% SPY/+14.2% IWM = put premium bid. VIX 24.6 vs 20.4 MA20 = elevated fear; VIXEQ 46.9 vs VIX 24.6 — a 22-point gap = high single-stock dispersion, rotation tape not macro-correlated. MOVE prints 0.0 (unavailable), no bond-vol read.

CROSS-ASSET — Energy is the lone green (USO +1.45%) while crude 20d is -15.03%: a bounce, not a trend; silver -2.60% with gold -1.76% and GLD -$5.55% 5d shows the metals unwind (SLV 20d -19.66%) as dollar holds (UUP +0.03%, 20d +2.53%). Next FOMC Dec 9, 2026: CME FedWatch prices hold 0.0%/cut 0.0%/hike 100%; Polymarket 92% for +25bp and 5% for +50bp (-3pp 5d).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50.3, Neutral. Movers: AMD -7.72%, PANW +6.42%, UNH -5.55% (3.5x vol), IJS -2.26% (15.9x vol). PANW's 2.8x volume with +6.42% is the lone accumulation print; UNH at 3.5x on -5.55% is distribution. Worst momentum: SOXX 20d -71.00%, SLV -19.66%; best XLU +0.33%. Watch: SOXX -2.75% (20d collapse, SOXX -$4.49bn outflow at 0p), IWM PCR 1.52 (max pain 270, put protection extreme), XLE -0.65% (only sector holding, flows -674mm — fragile leadership).
